observations: Photo 0: single four-way wooden pallet on bare concrete, boards show weathering and dark staining, a strip of red/orange material visible on one edge block.
Photo 1: same or similar pallet, closer top-down view, a visible split/crack running across one of the deck boards, nail heads visible, edges show wear.
Photo 2: a tall stack of many similar wooden pallets in an open yard/warehouse setting, suggesting bulk inventory rather than a single unit for sale.
No brand, manufacturer mark, or load-rating label visible in any photo.
No dimensions, size markings, or ISPM-15 stamp visible on any board.

claims.evidence: Photos 0, 1 and 2 all show typical wooden block/stringer pallets consistent with standard storage pallet construction.

claims.claim: Implied bulk availability (seller shows a stack of many)
claims.evidence: Photo 2 shows many pallets stacked, but it is not stated whether all are for sale or just one unit as in photos 0 and 1.

risks.risk: Cracked or splitting boards reducing load capacity and lifespan
risks.proof: Close-up photo of the crack seen in photo 1, and of the underside boards
risks.if_unproven: priced as a worn/cracked pallet, not as a sound full-strength pallet

risks.risk: Missing dimensions (standard pallets vary, e.g. 1000x1200mm vs 1100x1100mm) affecting usability and price per unit
risks.proof: A photo with a tape measure against the pallet length and width
risks.if_unproven: priced as a generic unspecified-size pallet, not matched to any premium standard size

risks.risk: Unclear nail/staple condition and protruding fasteners (safety/handling hazard)
risks.proof: Close-up of all four corner blocks and nail points
risks.if_unproven: priced assuming some protruding or loose nails needing rework

risks.risk: Unclear whether this listing is for one single pallet or the whole stack shown in photo 2
risks.proof: Seller confirmation with a photo showing a quantity label or count on the stack
risks.if_unproven: priced as a single unit only, matching photos 0 and 1

risks.risk: Wood moisture/rot not visible from distance, affecting durability
risks.proof: Close-up photo of the underside and any dark/soft patches
risks.if_unproven: priced as possibly damp or part-rotted, not kiln-dried grade

proof_requests: A tape-measure photo showing pallet length and width
A close-up of the cracked board seen in photo 1
A close-up of all four corner blocks and the underside
Confirmation of how many units are being sold (one vs the stack in photo 2)
response.reason: The item is clearly identifiable as a standard wooden storage pallet by type, but visible cracking and unproven dimensions/quantity mean it must be priced at the worst case for a single, worn, unspecified-size pallet until further proof is given.
